location: urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-013, applicability and unconditional property constraints
problem: The shape targets every nltl:ship but requires shipIceStrengthened=true and unconditionally requires the ice-class, waterline, draught inputs and draught comparison. This makes the conditional requirement apply to ships for which ice conditions do not require ice strengthening, and the SPARQL comparison is likewise not gated by applicability.
required_change: Encode an applicability gate allowing an explicitly non-applicable ship to pass while requiring shipIceStrengthened=true and enforcing all listed inputs and the fore/aft bounds comparison only for an applicable ship; preserve violation behavior when applicability evidence is missing.
regression_guard: Preserve the conditional scope: explicit false must bypass the requirement, explicit true must enforce every mandatory input and inclusive minimum-to-maximum comparison, and missing applicability evidence must remain a violation.
